_comment: Copy this file, mount it at POLICY_RULES_FILE (default /config/policy.json), and edit. Rules are evaluated in order, first match wins; falling off the end uses defaultTier. 'when' conditions: {"field":..,"op":..,"value":..} with op in eq/neq/gt/gte/lt/lte/in/exists, combined with {"all":[...]}/{"any":[...]}/{"not":...}. This file reproduces the built-in default ruleset used when POLICY_RULES_FILE is absent - it already works for Intune and Jamf devices alike via the normalized identity_found/compliant/last_checkin_age_hours/account_enabled facts (see README.md 'Policy engine' for the full fact reference, including the platform-specific facts these normalize from). AD/LDAP stays a separate, additive check - it has no compliance concept, just enabled/disabled - so it's not folded in here; add your own rule keyed on ad_device_found/ad_device_enabled if you want it to affect the decision.
